items.description: I ran enablement workshops, coached sales development reps, and built a help site for new hires. I worked with Sales and Marketing on how we introduced the company to educators.

I designed for print and the web, from apparel and printed pieces to pages built in WordPress. I prepared files for print vendors, presented designs to stakeholders, and used Google Analytics and Google Ads in my digital work.
I wrote a six-email nurture campaign for SAP and worked with senior creatives on campaign pitches. My projects also included SEO research and landing page copy.
